context: The signup endpoint currently returns HTTP 500 when an already-registered email is submitted.
problem: Duplicate signup attempts are treated as server failures instead of a bounded conflict outcome.

acceptance_criteria.observation_scope: POST /signup with an email already present in the user store
acceptance_criteria.expected_outcome: The API returns HTTP 409 and the user count does not increase.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Run the duplicate-email integration fixture and compare user count before and after the request.
indeterminate_when: The test fixture cannot establish the pre-request user count.

verification_evidence.how: Duplicate-email integration fixture exits successfully and records HTTP 409 plus unchanged user count.
Repository build completes successfully at the reviewed head SHA.

risks: A broad duplicate guard could incorrectly reject legitimate new users.

conditions: AC-1 evidence is collected at the reviewed head SHA.

assumptions: The duplicate-email fixture represents the current persistence semantics.
reversibility: The change can be reverted as one isolated service-layer commit.
data_privacy: Fixtures use synthetic email addresses only.
